notes.message: table reactions: `sync to members[.$message.conversation]` has no horizon, so every row of every group a device holds reaches it and stays; a device that holds many groups, or a public table that grows, pays for all of it at every cold start; `cap 50 by message` bounds the rows per message, not what a device acquires — `sync to members[.$message.conversation]` delivers every message's rows to every device; measure what it costs with `check --residency`
query chat.groupByTitle returns a page of 1 conversations rows with no cursor, so the page cannot continue
notes.rewrite: if the screen pages, declare `c: cursor ?` in chat.groupByTitle and append `after c` to this conversations page, keeping its current predicate, direction and column order

notes.message: query chat.groupByTitle: this lookup does not pin an authorized row's id; matching a name does not prove uniqueness or absence. The server may return matches but cannot certify complete. The held replacement (check --verbose) keeps the same matches and shape on the device; it requires acquired coverage and has no server fallback. Keep the original query if server lookup is required
notes.rewrite:
query groupByTitle(title: text 1..50) held:
  return conversations where .title = title and .kind = 'group' first 1 by .id

notes.message: maintain unread may disclose the delta of a hidden messages row: insert/delete and a potentially wider update rule affect this readable target; filter/key/value dependencies: conversation, ordinal, sender, tombstone

notes.message: posts: each contributing commit logs and streams the whole parent image per destination partition, coalesced once per row; a 4,000-byte parent costs every holder about 4 KB per change
notes.rewrite: use a column when readers want the count with the row; for a large row or a counter changing far more often than it is read, use a view with online only

predictionSummary: 6 mutations never predict: chat.createDM (reads online-only table dmKeys), chat.delivered (author marked this mutation : server), chat.setReaction (upsert on a read-through child queues without a row; the explicit update/insert alternative needs read authority and held key coverage, and may still queue past a horizon), chat.setTyping (writes online-only table typing), chat.stopTyping (reads online-only table typing), setFollow (reads online-only table follows); 6 mutations have insert arms that never predict: chat.setTyping (typing is online only), publish (posts has horizon last 1000 by $intent:byAt:31b7451344e6727f (at, id)), saveProfile (profiles has horizon last 1200 by byId (id)), setFollow (follows is online only), setLike (likes has horizon last 1000 by $intent:byAt:31b7451344e6727f (at, id)), setRepost (reposts has horizon last 1000 by $intent:byAt:31b7451344e6727f (at, id)); 10 mutations eligible, but these reads queue without a row past a horizon: chat.add (profiles[principal = principal] (chat.q:128:18)), chat.createGroup (profiles[principal = other] (chat.q:199:18)), chat.deleteMessage (messages by byId (chat.q:279:3), messages[message] (chat.q:276:7)), chat.editMessage (messages by byId (chat.q:274:3), messages[message] (chat.q:268:7)), chat.send (messages[quote] (chat.q:118:14), profiles[principal = viewer] (chat.q:337:12)), chat.sendMedia (messages[quote] (chat.q:261:14), profiles[principal = viewer] (chat.q:337:12)), placeAvatar (profiles by $intent:byPrincipal:8097d97fddadb304 (schema.q:28:3)), publish (insert posts (schema.q:115:10), posts[parentId] (schema.q:114:20)), setLike (delete likes (schema.q:121:5), insert likes (schema.q:119:5), likes[postId, viewer] (schema.q:120:18), posts[postId] (schema.q:117:18)), setRepost (delete reposts (schema.q:128:5), insert reposts (schema.q:126:5), posts by byId (insert reposts: posts/byId), posts[postId] (schema.q:123:7), reposts by byId (delete reposts: reposts/byId), reposts[viewer, postId] (schema.q:127:18)) — snapback4 why <op>

scaleSummary: scale: 38 of 59 operations are constant; 6 constant once background cleanup catches up (home, chat.history, chat.messageReceipts, chat.stopTyping, chat.setReaction, chat.messageReactions); 15 grow with data (people, chat.progress, chat.delivered, chat.groupByTitle, chat.typingIn, chat.typingInMyRooms, chat.dmFor, chat.inChat, chat.searchNewest, chat.searchHeld, chat.searchMessages, chat.apiHistory, chat.unreadInboxes, digest.daily, insights.trending); 1 job(s) assessed per chunk — `check --cost` gives the certificate
